label: Worldwide
summary: Internationally accessible plain English suitable for global readers
ISO standard currency codes (USD, EUR, GBP, INR, JPY) for unambiguous pricing
Neutral cross-cultural phrasing free of localized idioms
tone_principles: Culturally neutral, universally respectful, and globally accessible.
writing_style: Clear, direct international English avoiding regional slang and ambiguous colloquialisms.
messaging_principles: Specify time zones (UTC/GMT) and currency codes explicitly for multinational audiences.

rules.title: Avoid Regional Slang in Global Communications
rules.description: Global audiences require unambiguous phrasing free of culturally narrow regional idioms.
rules.do_example: We provide dedicated support to international enterprise partners.
rules.dont_example: We look forward to touching base offline with folks across the pond.

terminology.notes: Use clear international terminology for diverse global audiences.
